title: Generalized supported class characterized on the modified blowup
statement:
Let $i:Y\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes on which a fixed prime $\ell$ is invertible, with ideal $I$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $E$ be a rank-$r>0$ finite locally free $\mathcal O_Y$-module and $E\twoheadrightarrow I/I^2$ a surjection [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Put $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, $n\geq1$, with small-etale categories and Tate twists [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. Define
$$\mathcal A_a=I^a\times_{I^a/I^{a+1}}\operatorname{Sym}^aE,\qquad B_E=\operatorname{Proj}_X(\mathcal A_\bullet),\qquad\pi:B_E\to X,$$
using coefficientwise multiplication and relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj]. Then $\pi$ is projective, is an isomorphism over $U=X-Y$, and $\pi^{-1}Y=P(E)$. The sheaf $\mathcal O_{B_E}(1)$ is invertible and canonically trivial over $U$. If $E=I/I^2$ and $i$ is regular (locally cut out by a regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]), $B_E$ is the ordinary blowup $\operatorname{Proj}_X\bigoplus_a I^a$.
Using the Chern classes of [lem-per-noetherian-etale-chern-identities] and the pseudo-divisor operator of [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus], put $\xi=c_1(\mathcal O_{P(E)}(1))$ and
$$Q_E=-\sum_{a=0}^{r-1}(-1)^a p^*c_a(E)\xi^{r-1-a},\qquad G=G_{\mathcal O_{B_E}(1),1_U}.$$
There is a split distinguished triangle
$$\Lambda_X\longrightarrow R\pi_*\Lambda_{B_E}\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{a=1}^{r-1}i_*\Lambda_Y(-a)[-2a]\xrightarrow{0}\Lambda_X[1].$$
For every closed $C\subset Y$ the resulting pullback $H_C^q(X,\Lambda(t))\to H_{\pi^{-1}C}^q(B_E,\Lambda(t))$ is injective. For support $Y$ there is an exact sequence
$$0\to H_Y^q(X,\Lambda(t))\xrightarrow{\pi^*}H_{P(E)}^q(B_E,\Lambda(t))\to H^q(P(E),\Lambda(t))/p^*H^q(Y,\Lambda(t))\to0.$$
There is a unique class $\gamma_{i,E}\in H_Y^{2r}(X,\Lambda(r))$ whose pullback is $G(Q_E)$. It has restriction $i^*\gamma_{i,E}=(-1)^rc_r(E)$. For any morphism $v:X'\to X$ with $X'$ Noetherian and $Y'=X'\times_XY$, the pulled-back surjection $E'=v_Y^*E\twoheadrightarrow I'/I'^2$ satisfies $v^*\gamma_{i,E}=\gamma_{i',E'}$. For a surjection $E'\twoheadrightarrow E$ of vector bundles on $Y$ with kernel $K$ and constant $\operatorname{rank}E'=r'$, where $\gamma_{i,E'}$ is formed with the composite surjection $E'\twoheadrightarrow E\twoheadrightarrow I/I^2$, one has
$$\gamma_{i,E'}=(-1)^{r'-r}c_{r'-r}(K)\cdot\gamma_{i,E}.$$
Here the action and the supported groups are those of [lem-per-noetherian-supported-product-calculus]. The triangle, its maps, $Q_E$ and $G(Q_E)$ are natural for coefficient reduction $\mathbf Z/\ell^N\to\mathbf Z/\ell^n$ with the power-map Tate comparison. Regularity of $i$ is not assumed except in the indicated identification with the ordinary blowup.
